headline: South African Transport Costs Rise 10.8% as Food Price Increases Moderate
summary: Statistics South Africa reported consumer prices rose 4.5% year-on-year. While staple foods like maize meal fell 8.6%, transport costs surged 10.8%, with economists expecting headline inflation to exceed 5% in October.
why: Rising fuel and transport costs directly squeeze consumer purchasing power in South Africa, complicating monetary policy considerations for the South African Reserve Bank.
